releasedFrontmatter.name: name: tasks-for-bots
releasedFrontmatter.description: description: Track shared work, dependencies and status with the Ambitious Tasks CLI. Use when a user asks to remember work, change a task, finish work, find what to do next, inspect a process or plan assignments.

releasedFrontmatter.name: name: tasks-page
releasedFrontmatter.description: description: Present Ambitious Tasks board and next-work output in a Grok Bot Page. Use when a user wants a readable work board, task summary or explanation of what should happen next.

releasedFrontmatter.name: name: audit-collector
releasedFrontmatter.description: description: "Gather a collector document for ambitious-audit from the account the bot can see, and say honestly what it could not see."

releasedFrontmatter.name: name: audit-page
releasedFrontmatter.description: description: "Turn an ambitious-audit result into a page the customer can read. The module does not render the page."

releasedFrontmatter.name: name: snapshot-routine
releasedFrontmatter.description: description: "Run ambitious-audit on a schedule, show the result for review, and send a report only after the customer has approved that tool."

releasedFrontmatter.name: name: send-feedback
releasedFrontmatter.description: description: "Build a send_feedback document with ambitious-audit and hand it to the service after the customer approves the send."

releasedFrontmatter.name: name: contracts-for-bots
releasedFrontmatter.description: description: Maintain a literal-quote obligation register, apply amendments, inspect due work and hand suggested payloads to the tasks module.
